body.content: Speculation: If the Collatz sequence is viewed as a state-machine, the 'causal mechanism' demanded by the school stance might be found in the information-theoretic entropy of the bit-stream. Does the parity sequence of any n eventually lose enough information to be forced into the 4-2-1 attractor?
body.why_keep_this: Explores the connection between parity dynamics and the mechanist requirement.
